title: Longest-enrolled device
hints: Keep a variable for the best record so far, starting at None, and replace it whenever you see an earlier date.
ISO date strings compare with < directly; no parsing needed.
Use a strict < comparison so that an equal date does not replace the earlier record, and `continue` past records whose .get("enrolled") is None.
min(records, key=lambda d: d["enrolled"], default=None) is the one-line version once you have filtered out the undated records.
